grain.routes: Airline × source airport × destination airport × codeshare/stops/equipment record; not a flight or passenger

attribution: OpenFlights / jpatokal; airport sources OurAirports/DAFIF, routes Airline Route Mapper. See https://openflights.org/data.php
rights_scope: Archival airport/route databases and original visualizations from the permitted data, with attribution and share-alike database terms; no copied OpenFlights map images, logo or airline/plane tables. Source LICENSE retained.
observed_time_scope: Routes provider ceased updates June 2014 according to producer. Airport metadata retrieved at fixed repository commit, not a verified 2014 census. No schedules, traffic, fares, capacity or demand.
selection: Complete airports.dat and routes.dat at one fixed commit; no row sampling. All raw rows retained in Bronze/Silver; Gold keeps zero-stop, resolved ID-to-ID directed edges and collapses airline/codeshare repeats with counts.
privacy: No passengers, personal travel histories or student data.
snapshot_hash_definition: SHA256 of concatenated (filename + decompressed/raw SHA256) entries in manifest order, including LICENSE; per-file hashes also validated.
